name: Sunlit Chemist
observations: Dark blue fascia with white SUNLIT CHEMIST wording and green/blue medical cross.
Blue-framed lower entrance and display glazing over striped/grille-like lower panels.
Upper red brick has rectangular light windows under the sloping roof.
Narrow access gap separates this older row from the taller gabled B&M mass.
Retain gap/brick side wall and free-standing roadside shop-direction sign as separate features.
Reflective shop glass does not reveal a reliable interior layout.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
